messages.text: Verstappen surge continues with Singapore pole ahead of Ferraris

metadata.summary: Max Verstappen claimed his second pole position of the Singapore Grand Prix weekend to put himself at the head of the grid for Sunday's main race as Ferrari's wait for a first full pole of 2026 continued.
metadata.content: Singapore GP Qualifying: Max Verstappen claims pole position again as Charles Leclerc pips Lewis Hamilton to second on grid | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Breaking Singapore GP Qualifying: Max Verstappen claims pole position again as Charles Leclerc pips Lewis Hamilton to second on grid Max Verstappen's late-season surge continues after he turns tables on Ferrari in Q3; Charles Leclerc usurps team-mate Lewis Hamilton for second on final laps; Kimi Antonelli fourth; watch Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am) live on Sky Sports F1 Saturday 10 October 2026 16:21, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix. Max Verstappen claimed his second pole position of the Singapore Grand Prix weekend to put himself at the head of the grid for Sunday's main race as Ferrari's wait for a first full pole of 2026 continued. Lewis Hamilton had looked the favourite to deliver his first Grand Prix pole for Ferrari after topping the first two stages of qualifying but Red Bull rival Verstappen, who had won the day's earlier rain-hit Sprint having started on pole, seized the initiative in the first runs of Q3. Hamilton was a provisional second after the first runs but could not improve on his second attempt, and was then knocked off the front row to third by team-mate Charles Leclerc, who had experienced a low-key session up to then. messages.text: 'McLaren will be furious!' - Was Norris to blame for Piastri collision?

metadata.summary: The overtake Lando Norris attempted on Oscar Piastri that resulted in the McLaren team-mates crashing on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint was "not smart", according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle.
metadata.content: Singapore GP: McLaren 'will be furious' at Lando Norris-Oscar Piastri crash during Sprint, says Martin Brundle | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Singapore GP: McLaren 'will be furious' at Lando Norris-Oscar Piastri crash during Sprint, says Martin Brundle Lando Norris and his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri crashed on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint; the incident cost McLaren eight championship points; watch Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am) live on Sky Sports F1 Saturday 10 October 2026 12:39, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri make contact during the last lap of the Sprint race at the Singapore Grand Prix The overtake Lando Norris attempted on Oscar Piastri that resulted in the McLaren team-mates crashing on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint was "not smart", according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle. Norris had narrowly trailed Piastri in a battle for fourth for most of the 20-lap race at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, where overtaking is extremely difficult. Norris tried to go up the inside of Turn 5 on the final circuit, which led to a crash as Piastri turned in, with the Australian spun around as his rear-right tyre was struck by his team-mate's front-left.
